verdict.rationale: Relay is an online business-banking platform, so offering embedded banking accounts to a developer's own customers is a plausible axis for this kind of fintech product. However, the evidence only covers Relay's own direct-to-business accounts, cards, bill pay, invoicing and accounting syncs. Nothing in the pack shows a banking-as-a-service API, embedded-account program, or partner-bank licensing arrangement for developers.
